/onboarding/start/opening.v: Ana buɗe saiti. Idan babu abin da ya faru,

/onboarding/website/why.v: Muna karanta gidan yanar gizonku don nemo maƙalolin da za a gina wasiƙar labaranku da su, da kuma hasashen waɗanda masu karatunku suke.

/onboarding/website/skipNote.v: Idan ba ku da gidan yanar gizo tukuna, zaɓi batu kuma za mu yi amfani da shafin labarai game da shi.

/onboarding/website/noWebsite.v: Ba ni da gidan yanar gizo

/onboarding/website/topicHint.v: Za mu yi amfani da shafin labarai game da wannan batu a matsayin tushenku na farko. Kuna iya canza shi daga baya.

/onboarding/website/errors/empty.v: Shigar da adireshin gidan yanar gizonku don ci gaba.

/onboarding/website/errors/invalid.v: Wannan bai yi kama da adireshin yanar gizo ba. Duba rubutun, misali yourcompany.com.

/onboarding/website/errors/unreachable.v: Ba mu iya samun maƙaloli a wannan shafi ba. Gwada shafin blog ko labaranku, misali yourcompany.com/blog.

/onboarding/website/errors/network.v: Ba mu iya isa sabobinmu ba. Duba haɗinku kuma ku sake gwadawa.

/onboarding/readers/why.v: Muna rubuta kowace fitowa don wannan mai karatu, kuma a wannan harshe. Masu biyan kuɗi masu magana da wani harshe suna samun kwafin da aka fassara musu.

/onboarding/readers/skipNote.v: Mun cike waɗannan daga gidan yanar gizonku. Canza duk abin da bai yi daidai ba.

/onboarding/readers/languageHint.v: Mun zaɓi wannan daga saitunan burauzarku.

/onboarding/readers/readerHint.v: Jumla ɗaya ta isa. Misali: masu ƙananan gidajen abinci a Lisbon.

/onboarding/readers/readerPlaceholder.v: Ga wa wannan wasiƙar labarai take?

/onboarding/readers/errors/reader.v: Bayyana mai karatunku a 'yan kalmomi domin mu san wanda za mu rubuta wa.

/onboarding/preview/why.v: Wannan shi ne imel ɗin da masu biyan kuɗinku za su samu, wanda aka rubuta daga sabuwar maƙalarku. Ba a aika komai ba tukuna.

/onboarding/preview/generating.v: Ana rubuta fitowarku ta farko daga sabuwar maƙalarku. Yawanci wannan yana ɗaukar ƙasa da minti ɗaya.

/onboarding/preview/testSent.v: An aika gwaji zuwa {email}. Duba akwatin saƙonku da babban fayil na spam.

/onboarding/preview/skipPreview.v: Ci gaba ba tare da samfurin gani ba

/onboarding/preview/howBody.v: Mun ajiye gajeriyar doka da ke faɗa mana inda hanyoyin haɗin maƙaloli suke a shafinku, don haka ana watsi da menus da tallace-tallace. Sai kawai idan samfurin ya zaɓi abun ciki mara kyau za ku buƙaci canza ta.

/onboarding/preview/errors/generate.v: Ba mu iya rubuta fitowar ba. Wataƙila shafin yana hana karatun atomatik. Sake gwadawa, ko ku koma baya ku yi amfani da shafin blog ɗinku.

/onboarding/preview/errors/test.v: Imel ɗin gwaji bai tafi ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/onboarding/senderName/title.v: Yaya sunanku zai bayyana a akwatin saƙo?

/onboarding/senderName/why.v: Masu biyan kuɗi suna ganin wannan suna kusa da kowace fitowa, don haka suna gane ta kuma suna buɗe ta.

/onboarding/senderName/skipNote.v: Idan kun tsallake, mai aikawa zai bayyana a matsayin AIBAN. Kuna iya canza sunan daga baya a Saituna.

/onboarding/senderName/hint.v: Sunanku, sunan kamfaninku, ko sunan wasiƙar labarai. Har zuwa haruffa 60.

/onboarding/senderName/previewLabel.v: Yadda yake bayyana a akwatin saƙo

/onboarding/senderName/previewBody.v: Fitowarku tana bayyana da wannan sunan mai aikawa. Ana aika ta daga adireshin aikawa na AIBAN.

/onboarding/senderName/errors/empty.v: Shigar da sunan mai aikawa mai aƙalla haruffa 2.

/onboarding/senderName/errors/long.v: Ku bar sunan mai aikawa a haruffa 60 ko ƙasa da haka.

/onboarding/senderName/errors/save.v: Ba mu iya ajiye sunan ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/onboarding/signature/why.v: Sa hannunku yana zuwa a ƙarshen kowace fitowa, don haka masu karatu suna sanin wanda ya rubuta ta da yadda za su same ku.

/onboarding/signature/skipNote.v: Idan kun tsallake, fitowowi za su ƙare da sunan wasiƙar labaranku kawai.

/onboarding/signature/linkHint.v: Gidan yanar gizonku ko bayanin martaba na kafofin sada zumunta. Na zaɓi ne.

/onboarding/signature/previewLabel.v: Yadda yake bayyana a ƙarshen imel

/onboarding/signature/previewBody.v: Mun gode da karantawa. Sai a fitowa ta gaba.

/onboarding/signature/existingNote.v: Kuna da sa hannu tuni. Ajiyewa a nan zai maye gurbinsa.

/onboarding/schedule/title.v: Yaushe sababbin fitowowi za su tafi?

/onboarding/schedule/why.v: Muna duba gidan yanar gizonku kafin kowace aikawa kuma muna rubuta sabuwar fitowa daga sababbin maƙaloli.

/onboarding/schedule/skipNote.v: Kuna iya canza rana da lokaci, ko dakatar da aikawa, a kowane lokaci a dashboard.

/onboarding/schedule/recipeBody.v: A jadawalin da ke sama, muna zaɓar mafi kyawun sabuwar maƙalarku, mu rubuta ta a salonku, mu fassara ta ga kowane mai karatu, kuma mu aika ta ta imel.

/onboarding/schedule/recipeOff.v: A kashe. Fitowowi suna tafiya ne kawai idan kun danna Aika.

/onboarding/schedule/errors/create.v: Ba mu iya ajiye wasiƙar labaranku ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/onboarding/schedule/errors/limit.v: Tsarinku bai yarda da wani tushe ba. Don ƙara ɗaya, rubuto mana kuma za mu canza tsarinku.

/onboarding/send/why.v: Aikawa yanzu yana nuna muku cikakkiyar hanyar: fitowarku tana isa akwatin saƙo na gaske, a harshen mai karatu.

/onboarding/send/skipNote.v: Idan kun tsallake, fitowa ta farko za ta tafi a lokacin da kuka tsara.

/onboarding/send/youAreSubscribed.v: Kun riga kun yi rajista a matsayin {email}.

/onboarding/send/othersHint.v: Liƙa adiresoshin imel da waƙafi ko sabon layi ke raba su. Kowane mutum yana samun gayyata ta musamman daga gare ku. Suna karɓar fitowowi ne kawai idan sun amince, kuma muna share gayyatar da babu wanda ya amince da ita bayan kwanaki 30.

/onboarding/send/sentTitle.v: Fitowarku ta farko tana kan hanya

/onboarding/send/sentBody.v: Tana zuwa ga duk waɗanda ke jerinku da suka tabbatar da rajistarsu. Tana iya ɗaukar 'yan mintuna kafin ta isa.

/onboarding/send/invited.v: An aika gayyata ga mutane {count}. Za su shiga jerinku idan sun amince.

/onboarding/send/invitesUnavailable.v: Gayyata ba ta samuwa tukuna, don haka ba mu ajiye waɗannan adiresoshin ba. A mataki na gaba, kwafi hanyar haɗin rajistarku kuma ku aika musu da kanku.

/onboarding/send/errors/invalidEmails.v: Waɗannan adiresoshin ba su yi daidai ba: {list}. Gyara ko cire su.

/onboarding/send/errors/add.v: Ba mu iya gayyatar: {list}. Sake gwadawa daga baya daga Masu biyan kuɗi.

/onboarding/send/errors/send.v: Fitowar ba ta tafi ba. Sake gwadawa nan ba da jimawa ba.

/onboarding/share/title.v: Samu masu biyan kuɗinku na farko

/onboarding/share/why.v: Mutanen da suka yi rajista a nan suna samun kowace fitowa a harshensu.

/onboarding/share/skipNote.v: Kuna iya samun wannan hanyar da lambar sakawa daga baya a Masu biyan kuɗi, ƙarƙashin Fom ɗin rajista.

/onboarding/share/linkHint.v: Raba shi a kafofin sada zumunta, a ƙasan imel ɗinku, ko a lambar QR.

/onboarding/share/embedLabel.v: Fom ɗin rajista don gidan yanar gizonku

/onboarding/share/embedHint.v: Liƙa wannan lambar inda kuke son fom ɗin ya bayyana a gidan yanar gizonku.

/onboarding/done/why.v: Ga abin da zai faru na gaba da abin da ya rage a yi.

/tutorial/checklistDone.v: Komai ya shirya. Wasiƙar labaranku tana aiki da kanta yanzu.

/tutorial/items/source/title.v: Ƙara inda abun cikinku yake zuwa

/tutorial/items/source/body.v: Gidan yanar gizo ko blog da muke dubawa don sababbin maƙaloli.

/tutorial/items/sender/body.v: Sunan da masu biyan kuɗi ke gani kusa da kowace fitowa.

/tutorial/items/subscriber/title.v: Samu mai biyan kuɗinku na farko

/tutorial/items/subscriber/body.v: Wani da ba ku ba ya yi rajista ko aka ƙara shi.

/tutorial/items/send/body.v: Fitowa ɗaya ta gaske tana isa ga mutanen da ke jerinku.

/tutorial/items/automation/body.v: Sababbin fitowowi suna tafiya a jadawalinku.

/tutorial/items/widget/title.v: Ƙara fom ɗin rajista a gidan yanar gizonku

/tutorial/items/widget/body.v: Baƙi za su iya yin rajista ba tare da barin gidan yanar gizonku ba.

/tutorial/help/whyItMatters.v: Me ya sa yake da muhimmanci

/auth/emailHint.v: Muna aika lamba mai lambobi 6 zuwa wannan adireshin. Ba kwa buƙatar kalmar sirri.

/auth/codeSentTo.v: Mun aika lamba mai lambobi 6 zuwa {email}.

/auth/codeHint.v: Lambar na iya ɗaukar minti ɗaya kafin ta iso. Ku duba babban fayil na spam ma.

/auth/resendIn.v: Kuna iya neman sabuwar lamba cikin daƙiƙa {seconds}

/auth/resendLimit.v: Idan har yanzu lambar ba ta iso ba, rubuto mana daga shafin Taimako kuma za mu warware shi.

/auth/errors/email.v: Shigar da cikakken adireshin imel, misali you@company.com.

/auth/errors/send.v: Ba mu iya aika lambar ba. Duba haɗinku kuma ku sake gwadawa.

/auth/errors/code.v: Wannan lambar ba ta yi aiki ba. Duba lambobi 6 ɗin ko ku nemi sabuwar lamba.

/onboarding/schedule/summaryMonthly.v: A ranar 1 ga kowane wata da {time}, lokacinku ({zone}).

/auth/errors/busy.v: Shiga an dakatar da shi na ɗan lokaci saboda AIBAN ya kai iyakar bayanai na yau. Sake gwadawa bayan 'yan sa'o'i.

/auth/errors/tooMany.v: Kun nemi lambobi da yawa a jere. Jira 'yan mintuna, sannan kuma sake gwadawa.
